summary: The diff implements frontend admin authentication UI (login page, protected routes, session management via React Context) and basic route configuration. However, the backend admin authentication system (REQ-56, REQ-57) is completely missing. The frontend uses mock authentication instead of actual backend integration. Role-based access control in the backend is not implemented. Admin profile display in AdminPanel (REQ-61) shows username from frontend state but lacks role display and proper backend integration.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create backend admin authentication system in main.mo with stable variable for storing admin credentials (username and hashed password), and actor methods for admin login verification that returns a session token or admin principal identifier upon successful authentication
missing_requirements.reason: Backend main.mo shows no stable variable for admin credentials, no admin login method, no password hashing implementation, and no session token generation. The TODO comment in useAdminAuth.tsx confirms backend integration is pending.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement role-based access control in backend by adding admin role type to user profile data structure and creating guard methods that verify admin status before allowing access to admin-only operations
missing_requirements.reason: UserProfile type in backend/main.mo contains only name, email, and createdAt fields - no role field exists. No admin role type is defined, and no guard methods verify admin status for privileged operations.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin role display in AdminPanel header (part of REQ-61 acceptance criteria: Admin role is displayed if multiple admin types exist)
missing_requirements.reason: AdminPanel.tsx displays only username from frontend state. No role information is fetched from backend or displayed in the UI.

hallucinated_features.description: Mock authentication system with hardcoded credentials (username: admin, password: admin123) in useAdminAuth.tsx
hallucinated_features.reason: Implementation uses temporary mock authentication instead of actual backend integration. This was not requested and represents incomplete implementation rather than the specified backend-integrated authentication system.
